When fitness enthusiasts in India talk about the No. 1 whey protein, the title usually comes down to a mix of global reputation, sales volume, and domestic popularity. There isn't just one single official government metric, but the market is heavily dominated by a couple of top contenders:

- Optimum Nutrition \(ON\) Gold Standard 100% Whey: Globally and across major e\-commerce platforms in India, ON Gold Standard is widely regarded as the gold standard and the most iconic, best\-selling imported whey protein. It is famed for its consistent quality, 24g protein per scoop, and high\-end mixability.
- MuscleBlaze \(Biozyme / Whey Gold\): As the leading home\-grown Indian sports nutrition brand, MuscleBlaze consistently ranks as a No. 1 best\-seller on major Indian health platforms like HealthKart. Their Biozyme series is specifically tailored and clinically tested for the Indian body to improve protein absorption.

Other top\-tier, highly trusted brands frequently competing at the top of Indian market charts include Myprotein, Isopure, Avvatar \(notable for being 100% made in India from fresh cow's milk\), and AS\-IT\-IS Nutrition \(popular for budget\-friendly raw whey\). [0]
